name: button
purpose: Interactive control for user actions. Lives at `packages/webkit/src/components/actions/button/`.
useWhen: Trigger an action that needs a visible text label: in a form, dialog footer, toolbar or page header.
Mark the main action of a view with `kind="primary"` and the lesser ones with `secondary`, `outlined` or `transparent`.
Submit or reset a form with `type="submit"` / `type="reset"`.
A call to action that navigates: set `href` (and `target`) and it renders as an anchor with the same look.
avoidWhen: One default action with related alternatives in an attached menu → use `split-button`.
A standalone navigation link with a trailing icon and a ghost hover → use `link`.
The single AI or highlight entry point that must stand out from every other action → use `button-highlight`.
related: icon-button` — icon-only counterpart with the same sizes and a required `ariaLabel`; its `transparent` kind matches this one.
split-button` — joins a Button to a chevron menu of related actions.
button-highlight` — the same prop surface without `kind`, drawn with the brand gradient and a rotating glow rim.
mini-button` — compact text action with a brand-colored trailing icon for dense cards and tables.
toggle-group` — a group of mutually exclusive options, not a single action.
bestPractices: Keep one `kind="primary"` per view or region; use `danger` only for destructive actions.
Set `loading` while the action resolves: it swaps the icon for a spinner, sets `aria-busy` and suppresses `click`, so the handler needs no extra guard.
Use `iconPosition="leading"` for a glyph that names the action and `"trailing"` for one that points where it goes; add `animated` only on marketing CTAs with a trailing icon.
Put brand or product marks in the `prefix` slot; `icon` takes a PrimeIcons class.
label` is required and is the accessible name; never pass an empty string to get an icon-only control.

props.name: label
props.doc: Visible label text. Use `IconButton` for icon-only controls.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size token; affects height, padding, and typography.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables interaction and applies disabled tokens.

props.name: loading
props.doc: Shows loading state and disables activation.

props.name: icon
props.doc: PrimeIcons class for the icon drawn beside the label.

props.name: iconPosition
props.doc: Which side of the label the icon sits on. `leading` is a glyph that names the action; `trailing` is a glyph that points at where it goes.

props.name: animated
props.doc: Nudges a trailing icon along its axis on hover. Off by default; marketing CTAs opt in.

props.name: href
props.doc: When set, renders as a link (`<a>`).

props.name: type
props.doc: Native button type. `submit` lets the control submit its form; `disabled` and `loading` still block it. Ignored when `href` is set.

slots.name: prefix
slots.notes: A mark drawn before the label, ahead of a leading `icon`. It stays first when `iconPosition="trailing"`, so a brand mark and a trailing chevron can share one control.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'
</script>

<template>
  <Button
    kind="primary"
    size="large"
    label="Button"
  />
</template>
